Above: The 1925 Club Championships at Battersea Park. The final of the 1 mile championship for the Garnet Cup. Left to right: H.E.Footer, K.O'Kell, A.D.Pyer, G.J.Rees, W.D.Pritchard and F.L.Buckingham. The winner was Ken, in 4:41.2, from Buckingham and Footer. Just look at the crowds!
